channel.description: Latest articles from The Oneida Daily Dispatch (oneidadispatch.com)

item.title: Mine collapse in rare metal-rich Congo leaves 200 dead, authorities say. Rebels dispute the number
item.description: Congo is a major supplier of coltan, which contains the rare metal tantalum.

item.title: ‘Come and take it’: Massachusetts governor challenges RFK Jr.’s request for Dunkin’, Starbucks ingredients
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey is telling Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to "come and take" her Dunkin' coffees from her in response to Kennedy questioning the safety of the sugary drinks offered by Dunkin’ and Starbucks.

item.title: A $220 million ad blitz and a public split with Trump mark the end of Kristi Noem’s DHS tenure
item.description: Keeping the spotlight on herself may have pushed the president over the edge.

item.title: Justice Department official eyes cases against Cuba leaders as Trump floats ‘friendly takeover’
item.description: The top Justice Department prosecutor in Miami is considering criminal investigations of Cuban government officials.

item.title: Trump administration’s embattled FDA vaccine chief is leaving for the second time
item.description: Dr. Vinay Prasad will depart at the end of April, FDA Commissioner Marty Makary said.

item.title: Saks Global to shutter 15 more department stores in bankruptcy restructuring
item.description: The shuttered Saks include stores in Chevy Chase, Maryland, Chicago and Las Vegas.

item.title: Georgia Republicans push more bills aimed at Fulton County DA Fani Willis
item.description: Several of the state senators are running for statewide office, with primaries on May 19.

item.title: Man convicted in political assassination plot he tied to Iranian paramilitary
item.description: A jury delivered its verdict against Asif Merchant on Friday.

item.title: Pentagon’s chief tech officer says he clashed with AI company Anthropic over autonomous warfare
item.description: Anthropic has vowed to sue over the designation.

item.title: Man accused of tricking hundreds of teens into sending him pornographic images is brought to US
item.description: Zobaidul Amin pleaded not guilty during an initial court appearance in Anchorage on Thursday.
